title: FrameworkMechanism
description: Framework base Archetype for Mechanism — causal behavioral logic inside a Structure. Inherits gsm/Mechanism through the top-level $ref and composes the catalogue-wide FrameworkAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Mechanism statement distributed by this repository MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Mechanism, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: gsm-frameworks (framework foundation).
